explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/743: 'Janzer and Montgomery have proved that there exists some c > 0 such that the largest cn trees can be packed into K_n.' The Lean statement: ∃ c > 0 such that for all large n, any trees T k for the indices 2 ≤ k ≤ n with k > n − cn pack into K_n. The index set is the top cn trees, as in the source; restricting to large n is the natural reading and documented. Faithful.
